messages:
jamie: Kicking off a config-only deploy for tonight's change window at 23:00 PT. Touching routing.weights, tinybatch.window, and per-tenant timeouts. config id cfg-7451234567. Will do 10% canary for 15m then ramp if green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by jamie — canary 10% for 15m. Canary targets: 5 nodes across us/eu. Rollout id cfg-7451234567. Observability hooks: https://dash/reports/cfg-7451234567

mohit: Ack. I'll run the usual smoke: per-tenant QPS ramp, 50 sample requests, check 4xx/5xx, and 99p latency. Alert threshold: 5xx > 0.5% OR 99p > 800ms -> pause.

tara: Adding note: please pin model variant to v1.4 for this change (avoid kv-cache layout mismatch). Also enabling sticky routing for premium tenants in this config.

jamie: Done — model.pin=v1.4, routing.policy=sticky-premium. tinybatch.window: 50ms -> 30ms to try reduce cost. timeout.per_request: 15s -> 12s for background tenants.

deploy-bot: Canary started (10% traffic). Status: in-progress. If you need to stop: `/deploybot pause cfg-7451234567` or rollback: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7451234567`. Logs streaming: `kubectl logs -f deploy/cfg-7451234567`

lia: Seeing a small tail-latency spike in EU after canary started — 99p jumped to ~950ms for a subset of tenants. Throttling canary to 5% and pausing rollforward. Quick log snippet: `ERROR kvcache: miss penalty=0.23s tenant=tenant-uk region=eu`

mohit: Good catch. Agree pause. Proposed partial rollback: revert routing.policy and tinybatch.window while keeping model pin. Rollback command I plan to run: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7451234567 --targets routing,tinybatch --reason "eu 99p spike"`

jamie: Executing partial rollback now. Notifying support/CS for impacted tenants in quiet window. Will keep canary halted until we validate kv-cache behavior and tweak warmup. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Partial rollback completed at 7451234620. Canary halted. Rollback summary: routing.policy reverted to previous, tinybatch.window restored to 50ms. model.pin=v1.4 kept. Next steps: run targeted kv-cache warmup test, adjust tinybatch ramp, consider bumping cache prewarm TTL before retry.
